note: UE import contract of the diorama tray candidate. The candidate is built by art/pipeline-candidates/ASSET-TABLE-BASE-001/scripts/table_base_candidate.py (static_prop_candidate.py helpers, table-base pivot: board centre, flat top at Z=-3 uu, whole tray below). The adopt stage pins its bytes against reports/candidate-report.json + reports/fbx-readback.json. Not usable before the Tripo step: the candidate files do not exist yet. KNOWN GAP: ue-import (tripo_pipeline.py exec_ue_static_candidate) hard-codes the check pivot_base_centre (min Z = 0, bounds centred), which a tray below its top plane fails by design; expectations.pivot below is not read by the CLI yet (followup). Numbers are measurements or PROPOSED values, not budgets.
